FN-ARWLTSS-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 319
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Randy Wood
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 319 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of local government
to amend their respective local plumbing code to comply with this bill.
This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
